teaser: A microphone left on, humming faintly before anyone has said a word into it. That hum is close to what life path 3 feels like inside an INFJ. The 3 wants the feeling spoken, performed, shared out loud; the INFJ in you built a habit of holding feeling back until it has been checked twice for meaning. You are a person who can move a room and still spend the drive home replaying every sentence for what it really meant. The charm is real. So is the hesitation underneath it, the pause before the joke lands, the private editing nobody in the room can see.
